CLI for disassembly, validation, tracing, and execution of SBPF programs.

# Purpose
This file defines a command-line tool for working with an SBPF virtual machine program. It loads a program file, checks that the file is a regular file, reads it into memory, extracts ELF and SBPF loader data, creates the `fd_sbpf_program_t` and `fd_sbpf_syscalls_t` objects, and registers all VM syscalls. The helper [`fd_vm_tool_prog_create`](<#fd_vm_tool_prog_create>) prepares the program state for later use, and [`fd_vm_tool_prog_free`](<#fd_vm_tool_prog_free>) releases the allocated memory and VM objects.

The [`main`](<#main>) function dispatches four commands through `--cmd`: `disasm`, `validate`, `trace`, and `run`. `disasm` prints a disassembly of the loaded program, `validate` runs VM validation on the program, `trace` executes the program with an input file and prints trace data, and `run` executes the program and prints the result, instruction count, and elapsed time. The file also contains [`read_input_file`](<#read_input_file>), which loads an input file into memory and maps it into a single VM input region for `trace` and `run`.
